{{Quote|The history of the Sith, and those serving them, had been one of accidental arrival and exile.|[[Grand Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]], ''[[Testament of Varner Hilts]]''|<ref name="Spiral1">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 1|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Discovery of Korriban''' was the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] on the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], eventually leading to the creation of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].

==History==
===Discovery of Korriban===
{{Quote|I guided our creaking galleon through the hyperspace breakwater known as the Stygian Caldera, which could not have been accomplished without command of the Force.|Sorzus Syn's chronicle|<ref name="BoS" />}}
Following the defeat of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] at the [[Battle of Corbos]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|banished]] a number of captives to uncharted [[Realspace/Legends|space]] aboard a [[Dark Jedi galleon|galleon]]. The captives were known as the [[Exiles]], an assortment of Dark Jedi led by high-ranking [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] such as [[Remulus Dreypa]], [[Ajunta Pall]], [[Karness Muur]], [[XoXaan]], and [[Sorzus Syn]]. With the guidance of the latter, the Exiles' flight into the unknown was not without direction; after [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of cataloging rumors and extracting information from [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], Syn eventually led the Dark Jedi to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. The twelve surviving Exiles made landing at the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of Sleeping Kings]] on the world, and they were greeted by the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. When Ajunta Pall beheaded the [[Sith King]] [[Hakagram Graush]], the Sith were convinced that the Exiles were gods, allowing the Exiles to subjugate the Sith and establish the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="BoS" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|After many centuries some of us have interbred with the Sith... while others still bear true Jedi blood.|[[Marka Ragnos]]|<ref name="Golden Age 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>}}
By subjugating the Sith species<ref name="BoS" /> following the Discovery of Korriban,<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|Account of the Discovery of Korriban}}</ref> the exiled [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] found a haven on Korriban for practicing the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], plotting and waiting to exact their revenge on the Jedi in the meantime.<ref name="Spiral1" /> Over the following 1900 years,<ref name="JvS" /> the Sith and the Exiles interbred<ref name="Golden Age 2" /> using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]<ref name="evil">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> and the Sith Empire entered a [[Golden Age of the Sith|Golden Age]].<ref name="Golden Age 2" />

Sorzus Syn later wrote of the event in her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]], which was later collected by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] into his ''[[Book of Sith]]''. Syn considered the Exiles' arrival to be solidified by their triumph over the Sith species.<ref name="BoS" /> An [[account of the Discovery of Korriban]] was also recorded in [[Language/Legends|scripture]] and existed as a memorabilia of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Discovery of Korriban was introduced in flashbacks in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 0|prologue issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series' [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith|''Golden Age of the Sith'']] sub-series,<ref name="Golden Age 0">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 0|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 0]]</ref> published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[July 31]], [[1996]], with writing by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and illustrations by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]]<ref name="Marvel0">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54589/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996)}}</ref> The event was later named in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
